title: Filtered free resolution with a larger module carrier universe
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring in universe $u$, and let $M$ be a cochain complex of $A$-modules with carriers in universe $\max(u,v)$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. There exist a complex $P$ and a quasi-isomorphism $q:P\to M$ [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], complexes $F_n$ for $n\in\mathbb N$, maps $\iota_n:F_n\to P$, and maps $s_n:F_n\to F_{n+1}$ such that $F_0$ is zero, all $\iota_n$ are monic, $s_n\iota_{n+1}=\iota_n$, every element of every degree of $P$ belongs to an $F_n$, each component of every $s_n$ admits a retraction, and for each $n$ there is a set $I$ in universe $\max(u,v)$ and integers $d_i$ with $\operatorname{coker}(s_n)\cong\bigoplus_{i\in I}(\operatorname{ULift}A)[-d_i]$ as cochain complexes. Here the summand has its only nonzero module in degree $d_i$, and $\operatorname{ULift}A$ denotes the rank-one $A$-module with carrier in the specified universe.

proof.text: Let B=ULift A and use the ring equivalence B≃A to regard M as a complex of B-modules. Apply [lem-pc-derived-filtered-free-resolution] in universe max(u,v).

Apply the inverse module-category equivalence degreewise to the resolution and filtration. Compose the transported augmentation with the inverse of the complex equivalence unit. Exact equivalences preserve quasi-isomorphisms; their complex functors preserve zero objects and monomorphisms. Functoriality gives step compatibility, and applying the inverse functor to the degreewise retractions gives the splitting identities. The carriers and functions are unchanged under scalar restriction, so elementwise exhaustion is unchanged.

Identify the cokernel of each transported step with the transported cokernel via PreservesCokernel.iso. Transport its free quotient isomorphism, then use the inverse sigmaComparison to commute the equivalence with its coproduct. Use singleMapHomologicalComplex on each summand; the transported rank-one module is definitionally ULift A with its usual A-action.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_large_filtered_free_resolution {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) ℤ) :
    ∃ (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) ℤ) (q : P ⟶ M),
      QuasiIso q ∧
      ∃ (F : ℕ → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) ℤ)
        (ι : ∀ n, F n ⟶ P) (step : ∀ n, F n ⟶ F (n + 1)),
        IsZero (F 0) ∧
        (∀ n, Mono (ι n)) ∧
        (∀ n, step n ≫ ι (n + 1) = ι n) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℤ) (x : P.X k), ∃ (n : ℕ) (y : (F n).X k), (ι n).f k y = x) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ),
          ∃ r : (F (n + 1)).X k ⟶ (F n).X k,
            (step n).f k ≫ r = 𝟙 ((F n).X k)) ∧
        (∀ n, ∃ (I : Type (max u v)) (degree : I → ℤ),
          Nonempty (cokernel (step n) ≅
            ∐ (fun i : I =>
              (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (degree i)).obj
                (ModuleCat.of A (ULift.{v} A)))))
